summary: Validated public CollaboNet API and core creator/company browser flows. Auth guard, demo login, overview, seeded campaigns, creator application, creator search filters, detail reviews, and disabled AI behavior passed.
action_items: Continue coverage for contract signing/completion, calendar mutation, notifications read state, account templates, and company campaign publishing in a follow-up run.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. One e2e creator application was submitted to an existing open campaign during browser testing; no production records were deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Creator and company demo sessions were verified against the public URL. Creator Maya has no seeded invitation by design; Jonas has the seeded invitation. AI is intentionally MOCKED/DISABLED and status=false with AI POST returning 503. Follow-up should use narrowly scoped e2e-prefixed data for remaining CRUD flows.
rca of the issue: Initial browser assertions hit expected React Query loading states before API data settled; explicit waits resolved this and no functional defect was reproduced.
